svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 06 · Merced · 02/12 Vernal Pools (Rare)
svg.desc: Winter rain fills shallow pools in the grassland. In spring they bloom in rings, yellow and white. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
